_meta.source: vanilla NR MSB dump (300 MSBs, 5382 chr Parts)
_meta.description: Authoritative catalog of boss-tier slots in vanilla NR MSB Part lists. Used by oops_v3 to identify OOPS_ALL_NB intercept targets without relying solely on variant-name marker substrings.

tier_categories_doc.named_boss: Curated boss chr names lacking tier markers (BKA, Astel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Troll, etc.) with non-zero entity_id.

_meta.filter_note: Excluded c-prefixes (Nightlord arenas: c7500-c7920, placeholders: c0000/c0100/c0120, etc.) are filtered out — these slots are permanently source-protected by the engine, so cataloguing them as boss-slots would give a misleading signal.
change_notes: v0.25.0-patch2: added 4 missing NB arenas — m48_90 (Large Wormface), m49_18 (Great Wyrm Theodorix), m49_19 (Ancient Dragon), m49_20 (Fallingstar Beast). Catalog-blind status was producing is_boss=False and catalog_tier=None for imported_chr swaps at these slots; downstream the wake-handshake / scripted_intro routing didn't fire and bosses failed to start. Empirical: seed 42 N2 fail, seed 650833 N1 fail — same pattern at m49_18 + m49_20 across both. Primary boss entry only; companion/prelude slots can be added by future re-audit.
